third_party_rule: built-in (third_party=false) if match name starts with 'ADBE ', 'Pseudo/ADBE ', 'CC ', 'CS ', 'APC ', 'Mettle' or 'mocha', contains 'Keylight', or is one of the Adobe-bundled names CINEMA 4D Effect, Cryptomatte, EXtractoR, IDentifier, CSRainfall, CSSnowfall (Mettle, mocha and Keylight were added because they ship with After Effects); generated 'Pseudo/@@' effects are third_party=false with generated=true; everything else (VISINF, ISL, ...) is third_party=true. Name-prefix heuristic, category not used; VISINF and ISL are a guess.
